title: make_params
description: Looks for files in a directory and turn it in a params file.

base_dir.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `/path/to/dir`

pattern.description: An optional regular expression. Only file names which match the regular expression will be matched.

n_dirname_drop.description: For every matched file, the parent directory will be traversed N times.

n_basename_id.description: The unique identifiers will consist of at least N dirnames.

id_name.description: The name for storing the identifier field in the yaml.

path_name.description: The name for storing the path field in the yaml.

group_name.description: Top level name for the group of entries.

output.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `params.yaml`

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
